Beginner
2B  Grammar and vocabulary
Description
Students discuss personal possessions and practise using possessive adjectives; possessive s
Lesson link
Use this activity after exercise 1c, page 16
Time
10 minutes
Extra material A small bag for each group or one bag for the class
Instructions
a Divide SS into groups of three or four. Give each
group a bag (or pass one bag around the class).
Ask SS to secretly put one of their possessions in
it.
b Gather in the bag(s). Pick up a possession from
one of the SS’ desks, e.g. a pen. Say ‘This is
_____’s pen.’ Write it on the board. Elicit ‘Is this
____’s pen?’ ‘Yes, it is. / No, it isn’t.’ Do some brief
fluency drills.
c Give out one bag of possessions to each group
or ask each student to take one object from the
bag. Explain that SS have two minutes to look
at the possession and decide who each object
belongs to. Tell SS to refer to the language on the
board. (Higher level SS could give a reason for
their answer, e.g. ‘I think it’s Pietro’s MP3 player
because he likes music.’)
d After two minutes ask some SS to ask across the
classroom to see if they have guessed correctly.
For example, ‘Elena, is this your mobile phone?’
‘Yes, it is.’ / ‘No, it isn’t.’
e Write any useful vocabulary, phrases, or
corrections on the board for the class to copy.
